tasks.prompt: cd /Users/ethan/code/gemini-cli && git fetch upstream main && NEW_COMMITS=$(git log HEAD..upstream/main --oneline | wc -l) && if [ "$NEW_COMMITS" -gt "0" ]; then echo "有 $NEW_COMMITS 个新提交，开始同步..." && git stash && git merge upstream/main --no-edit && npm run build && npm test && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: sync upstream/main ($(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'))" --no-verify || echo "合并或构建失败，请检查"; else echo "无新提交"; fi
